userIdea.description: ไอเดียคลิป: คลิปเกี่ยวกับอะไร/ประเด็นหลัก/สิ่งที่อยากให้เกิดขึ้น

continuityNotes.description: Optional fixed character, wardrobe, props, setting, story arc, and transition details. If empty, the skill must generate shared CONTINUITY NOTES and a reusable Continuity Lock from the idea/reference images.

referenceNotes.description: Optional notes for attached reference images or generated visual identity. If empty, the skill must infer shared REFERENCE NOTES/visual bible from the idea and reference images, without absence-only boilerplate.

contentMode.description: Storyboard content mode. Use news_narration for short news explainer clips with contextual background visuals.

newsScript.description: Optional full news text/script. If empty in news_narration mode, use userIdea as the source news text.

newsLanguageMode.description: How to choose spoken language for news narration.

newsSpeechPace.description: Spoken delivery pace for news narration. Use brisk_news by default to avoid slow, drawn-out Veo delivery while staying natural.

audioPersona.description: Persona-based audio cue for the spoken voice. auto_match lets the skill choose the best cue from the content mode, character, and use case.

videoAudioWorkflow.description: How Media Studio should handle audio after video generation. native means Veo creates audio in each video. separate_* means prompts should be suitable for visual-only video and Media Studio will generate voice/music tracks separately for the video editor.

separateVoiceModel.description: Audio model ID for separate voiceover generation when videoAudioWorkflow includes voice.

separateMusicModel.description: Audio/music model ID for separate background music generation when videoAudioWorkflow includes music.

separateMusicPrompt.description: Optional shared music direction for separate music generation. If blank, infer from Sound Design and continuity notes.

storyboardAudioTimingMode.description: Runtime-only Media Studio audio timing mode for separate voice storyboard generation.

storyboardAudioDurationSeconds.description: Measured voiceover audio duration from Media Studio. When > 0 and videoAudioWorkflow includes separate voice, the storyboard prompt count must align to this duration.

storyboardClipDurationSeconds.description: Runtime video clip duration used by Media Studio for each generated storyboard video.

storyboardAudioPromptCount.description: Runtime target prompt count computed as ceil(storyboardAudioDurationSeconds / storyboardClipDurationSeconds).

storyboardAudioSourceName.description: Runtime display name of the generated/uploaded voiceover audio used for timing.

storyboardPreparedVoiceoverScript.description: Exact voiceover script used to generate the prepared audio. If present, separate-audio storyboard output must keep VOICEOVER SCRIPT aligned with this text.

newsBackgroundStyle.description: How background visuals should support the news content.

newsClipDensity.description: How many news clips to target. Completeness always wins: compact still adds more clips when needed to finish the story.

maxSpokenSecondsPerClip.description: Maximum spoken-dialogue time per video clip. Keep below the configured clip duration so each prompt can be sent separately.

veoModel.description: Veo 3.1 model to target in Media Studio. REFERENCE_2_VIDEO is supported only by Veo 3.1 Fast.

veoProviderModel.description: Resolved provider model ID from Media Studio. This allows future Veo model IDs to pass through without changing the skill schema.

generationType.description: Veo 3.1 generation mode. FIRST_AND_LAST_FRAMES_2_VIDEO needs one or two dragged reference images: @Image1 as start frame and @Image2 as end frame when provided. REFERENCE_2_VIDEO needs one to three dragged reference images and Veo 3.1 Fast.

resolution.description: Runtime alias for outputQuality used by Media Studio model inputs.

enableTranslation.description: Whether Veo should translate non-English prompt/dialogue content before generation.

enableFallback.description: Whether Kie/Veo may fall back to a compatible generation route when the selected route is unavailable.

watermark.description: Optional watermark string to pass to Veo 3.1.

referenceImageUsageNotes.description: Optional notes for how dragged Media Studio reference images should be used in the selected Veo mode. Use @Image1, @Image2, @Image3 handles.

dialogueLanguage.description: ภาษาของบทพูด (dialogue) ที่ตัวละครพูด

style.description: สไตล์ภาพ/งาน 3D/2D ที่ต้องการ (ระบุให้ชัดเจน)

targetDurationSeconds.description: ความยาวรวมของเรื่อง (วินาที). Runtime audio-first storyboard timing may raise this above the normal short-form UI range.

sceneCount.description: จำนวนฉาก/prompt. Runtime audio-first storyboard timing may raise this to match measured audio duration.

maxPromptLength.description: Maximum character length per provider prompt. Multi-prompt packages such as news_narration and audio-first storyboard must keep every required prompt block and must not truncate the whole package.

aspectRatio.description: Veo 3.1 aspect ratio. Use auto, 16:9, or 9:16.

viralStrategy.description: แนวทางไวรัลที่อยากให้ใช้

tone.description: โทนการเล่าเรื่อง/คาแรกเตอร์

backgroundMode.description: โหมดพื้นหลังของวิดีโอ: ฉากปกติ หรือ green screen

includeTextOverlays.description: แสดงข้อความบนจอ (text overlay) หรือไม่เท่านั้น ไม่กระทบเสียงพูดของตัวละคร

characters.description: ตัวละครหลัก (ถ้าไม่ระบุ agent จะสร้างให้เหมาะกับไอเดีย)

role.description: เช่น hero/villain/narrator(ไม่แนะนำ)/seller/parent

personality.description: นิสัย/คาแรกเตอร์สั้นๆ

voice.description: โทนเสียง เช่น high/low/soft/raspy

setting.description: สถานที่/บรรยากาศหลักของเรื่อง (ถ้าไม่ระบุ agent จะเลือกให้)

product.description: ข้อมูลสินค้า (ถ้าเป็นคลิปขาย/ป้ายยา)

ctaText.description: ข้อความ Call-to-action เช่น กดตะกร้า/ลิงก์

constraints.description: ข้อกำกับการสร้างวิดีโอ/เสียง
